short_summary: Searched broadly for upcoming Polokwane-metro events (markets, gigs, sport, heritage, design fairs). WebFetch to almost all external domains was blocked by the network egress proxy this run, limiting verification to WebSearch snippets only, which repeatedly surfaced inconsistent/conflated dates (e.g. Capricorn Heritage Fest vs Doek On Fleek Lekompo Fest) and thin single-aggregator listings (Demi Lee Moore, Hotel & Home Design Fair, SKM Presents, Polokwane Melodic Festival, Botlokwa Braai Festival -- also outside Polokwane metro). Only the recurring Baobab Night Market at Meropa Casino cleared the 3-independent-non-resale-source bar (venue site suninternational.com, organiser Facebook/Instagram, and independent listing bizcommunity.com), published for its next two confirmed dates (30 Oct and 18 Dec 2026). 12 other candidates discarded for lacking independent corroboration or geographic scope.
